interpretation: The ML accuracy ceiling of 0.096 eV [0.082, 0.109] eV is consistent with the RSS floor of 0.128 eV computed from three independent measured noise sources: (A) inter-laboratory spread 0.072 eV RMS (20% of molecules exceed model MAE), (B) the vertical descriptor systematic offset 0.195 eV MAE (r²=0.70 correlation sTDA–ORCA adiabatic), and (C) functional dependence spanning 0.296 eV mean (0.58 eV max). The model outperforms the dummy baseline (0.107 eV) but cannot penetrate below the noise floor.
